bullets.text: A school student died after being hit by an express train while crossing the tracks near Tiruttani, and the office should monitor railway safety measures.
Auto drivers staged a sudden protest in Pethikuppam near Uthukottai and Gummidipoondi demanding the cancellation of free bus travel, which the district team should watch.
Governments helped tribal communities in Pazhaverkadu become entrepreneurs by assisting with fish and crab farming, and the office should support local development.
CapitaLand opened a new data centre in Chennai targeting hyperscalers, and the portfolio team should track this expansion in digital infrastructure.
The Telangana government invited Tamil Nadu businesses to join its growth journey and develop a drone park, which the ministry should review.

stories.title: தண்டவாளத்தை கடக்க முயன்ற போது விரைவு ரயில் மோதி பள்ளி மாணவர் பலி: திருத்தணி அருகே சோகம்
takeaways: A school student died after being hit by an express train while crossing tracks near Tiruttani.
Railway authorities have reiterated warnings for students and locals to avoid unauthorized track crossings.

stories.title: பழவேற்காட்டில் பழங்குடியினரை தொழில்முனைவோராக்கிய அரசுகள்: நண்டு, கொடுவா,‘கிளென்பிஷ்’ மீன்கள் வளர்க்க உதவி
takeaways: Tribal communities in Pulicat, Thiruvallur district, received government assistance to cultivate crabs and fish.
The project successfully transforms local fishermen into independent entrepreneurs with sustainable income streams.

stories.title: வீடுகளில் சூரிய மின் உற்பத்தி திட்டம்: அம்பத்தூரில் விழிப்புணா்வு முகாம்
takeaways: The Ambattur electricity division organized an awareness camp regarding rooftop solar power installations.
Residents were informed about government subsidies and procedures to set up net-metered solar units on homes.

stories.title: CapitaLand opens data centre in Chennai, targets hyperscalers
takeaways: CapitaLand Investment opened its second Indian data centre in Chennai under its Singapore-listed trust.
The facility is designed to attract global hyperscalers and expand the state's digital infrastructure capacity.

stories.title: Telangana invites Tamil Nadu businesses to join its growth journey
takeaways: Telangana announced the development of an exclusive 200-acre drone park with upcoming industry regulations.
State officials invited Tamil Nadu entrepreneurs to invest and participate in Telangana's expanding tech ecosystem.
